title: Universal Filename Policy
purpose: This policy establishes one universal filename standard for documents, records, reports, templates, and shared artifacts so files remain readable, sortable, system-safe, automation-friendly, and consistent across teams, devices, repositories, and time.

allowed_characters.date_hyphen_exception: Hyphens are allowed only inside the final ISO date token yyyy-mm-dd

token_order.name: subject
token_order.description: Primary project, client, process, system, or topic

token_order.name: document_type
token_order.description: Standard type such as policy, guide, report, audit, requirements, template

normalization_pipeline: replace spaces and separators with underscores
map terms to approved document type vocabulary when possible

prohibited: Unified Hub Business Requirements Document (BRD) / Functional Requirements Document (FRD) Hybrid
AI session mandatory operating rules FINAL
SYSTEM DIRECTIVE: SYSTEMATIC ARCHITECTURE AND STRUCTURAL AUDIT

session_normalized.input: Unified_Hub_Business Requirements Document (BRD) / Functional Requirements Document (FRD) Hybrid
SYSTEM DIRECTIVE: SYSTEMATIC ARCHITECTURE AND STRUCTURAL AUDIT

machine_validation.pass_condition: Filename matches validation_regex and contains no forbidden terms.
fail_actions: return validation error with rule explanation
offer normalized suggestion based on tokenized input
